CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
February 22, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF ROBIN MILLER FOR HER DEDICATED SERVICE TO THE COMMUNITY - It is recommended the City Council present Robin Miller with a plaque in recognition of her service to the La Mirada community.
5.1 Recognition of Robin Miller
5.2
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Marlin Munoz for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.2 Recognition of City Employee
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION - It is recommended the City Council appoint Miguel Meza to the Public Safety and Traffic Commission for a term ending in June 2022.
7.1 Appointment to the PS&T Commission
7.2
APPOINTMENTS TO THE YOUTH COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Natalia Zuniga and Hyunjun Kim and appoint Mirabelle Trunk, Katherine Jimenez, Genevieve Silebi, Ethan Revere, Andrew Morales, and Johny Eskondar to the La Mirada Youth Council for a term ending in October 2022.
7.2 Appointments to the Youth Council
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of February 8, 2022 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of February 8, 2022.
8.1 Minutes of 2-8-22 CC
8.1 Minutes of 2-8-22 SS
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated February 22, 2022 in the total amount of $1,765,660.92.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-08, CREEK PARK VEHICLE BRIDGE REPLACEMENT - APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL/TECHNICAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH RRM DESIGN GROUP - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the On-Call Professional/Technical Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and RRM Design Group to provide professional design services for CIP No. 2021-08, Creek Park Vehicle Bridge Replacement, based on the RRM Design Group revised proposal dated January 14, 2022, for a not to exceed fee of $229,686; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services to RRM Design Group, if required, for up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount.
8.3 CIP No. 2021-08
8.4
APPROVAL OF FACILITY USE FOR THE LA MIRADA-WHITTIER AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY RELAY FOR LIFE FUNDRAISING EVENT - It is recommended the City Council approve the change of date request for use of Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center for the American Cancer Society Relay for Life fundraiser event.
8.4 Approval of Facility Use
8.5
AGREEMENT WITH THEATER DIRECT, INC. FOR TELEMARKETING SERVICES FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Theater Direct, Inc. for telemarketing services for the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.5 Agreement with Theater Direct
8.6
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING DECEMBER 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending December 2021.
8.6 Monthly Treasurer Report
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
ORDINANCE NO. 722 AMENDING THE ZONING CODE, TITLE 21 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE AS FOLLOWS: AMEND SECTION 21.76.020 OF CHAPTER 21.76, SIGNS; AMEND SUBSECTION 21.76.050(6) OF CHAPTER 21.76, SIGNS; AMEND TABLE 21.76.070, OF CHAPTER 21.76, SIGNS; AMEND SECTION 21.76.130 OF CHAPTER 21 SIGNS; ADD SECTION 21.76.140 TO CHAPTER 21.76, SIGNS; AMEND SECTION 21.114.020 OF CHAPTER 21.114, SITE PLAN REVIEW; AND APPROVAL OF THE ASSOCIATED MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; affirm the Mitigated Negative Declaration; and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 722 amending Section 21.76.020 of Chapter 21.76, Signs, if Title 21; Subsection 21.76.050(6) of Chapter 21.76, Signs, of Title 21; Table 21.76.070, of Chapter 21.76, Signs, of Title 21; Section 21.76.130 of Chapter 21 Signs of Title 21; Section 21.114.020 of chapter 21.114, Site Plan Review, of Title 21; add Section 21.76.140 to Chapter 21.76, Signs of Title 21, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 PH - Ordinance No. 722
